items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: And then I went back with him in the studio

ctx.x: And that was the first time you had ever done that. And you not only wrote it but you played it, right?

No, let me put it this way. I didn't write it. You see, because what I did, I took the moog home and set the stops to the string -- he just wanted a string sound, you know? And then I went back with him in the studio and you know how Jimmy plays -- he's beautiful the way he plays, but overdubbed this -- this is where that writing and simplicity, that discipline comes in. So I would go out and play and I would show him what I wanted him to do. And he did it beautifully. I'd go in the booth with his wife, who is a…
I've been very lucky in that I haven't -- oh, I know
